name: trentesix
description: Trentesix, a design system in looks (from se mettre sur son trente-six, to put on one's finest): @trentesix/core and one package per look.

scripts.check: node scripts/build.mjs --check && stylelint packages/core/moments.css packages/core/src/calm.css "packages/*/src/moments.css" && prettier --check .
scripts.release: pnpm build && pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm smoke && changeset publish
